basic_details.job_title: NIH Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 6 MTS, Library Information Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH) will hold walk-in interviews on 15, 22, 23 and 24 December 2026, with reporting at 09:30 A.M. on all dates, at its Academic Building, Block GE, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106. The six contract posts are Library Information Assistant (2), Junior Hindi Translator (1), MTS (Aya/Ward Boy) (2) and MTS (Safaiwala) (1), with consolidated pay of Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 35,400 a month.

age_limit.details: For all four posts, the upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to the SC/ST category and Govt. Autonomous Body Employees, in accordance with the Orders issued by Govt. of India from time to time. The notice also states that the reservation policy is maintained as per the extant guidelines of Govt. of India, issued and amended from time to time. The notice does not print category-wise vacancies. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About NIH
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Homoeopathy is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India. Its headquarters are at Block-GE, Sector-III, Salt Lake, Kolkata-700106, and the notice also lists a satellite campus at Sector-A8, Chaudhary Ramdev Chowk, Narela, Delhi-110040. This notice is dated 23 November 2026 and the posts are filled on contract basis for one (01) year, or till filling up of the posts on regular basis, or till further orders, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Annexure-I asks for the candidate's name in block letters, father's or husband's name, mother's name, date of birth, age as on the interview date, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, category (SC/ST/OBC/PwD), whether working in Central/State/UT/Autonomous Body, languages known, addresses, telephone number, e-mail ID, Aadhaar number, educational qualification from Matriculation onwards, experience, and any other supporting information. It ends with a signed declaration that the information is true and correct.

faq.question: Q1. What are the NIH walk-in interview dates for 2026?
faq.answer: The dates are 15.12.2026 for Junior Hindi Translator, 22.12.2026 for Library Information Assistant, 23.12.2026 for MTS (Aya/Ward Boy) and 24.12.2026 for MTS (Safaiwala).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 09:30 A.M. on all scheduled dates. The venue is National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH), Academic Building, Block GE, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in NIH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts: Library Information Assistant 2, Junior Hindi Translator 1, MTS (Aya/Ward Boy) 2 and MTS (Safaiwala) 1.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the MTS posts?
faq.answer: MTS (Aya/Ward Boy) needs Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized State/Central Board and the ability to read and write English and local language. MTS (Safaiwala) needs literacy in Local language.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Junior Hindi Translator?
faq.answer: A degree in Hindi/English from a recognized university with English/Hindi respectively as ancillary subject, at least one year diploma in Hindi Translation, and a speed of 30 wpm in Hindi/English.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 35 years for Library Information Assistant and not exceeding 28 years for the other three posts, as on the date of interview. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates and Govt. Autonomous Body Employees.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration is ₹ 35,400/- per month for Library Information Assistant, ₹ 25,500/- for Junior Hindi Translator and ₹ 18,000/- for each MTS post. No other allowances are paid.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the Annexure-I application, original and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents supporting eligibility, and one passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely on contract basis for one (01) year, or till filling up of the posts on regular basis, or till further order, whichever is earlier. Candidates have no right to claim permanent employment.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA/Local Conveyance/boarding-lodging charges are admissible for attending the walk-in interview.
